tasks.title: Implement lazy HNSW runtime and native packaging support
tasks.action: Add lazy main-process HNSW wrapper, atomic derived-index swap, tombstone filtering, settings-driven compaction markers, optional hnswlib-node bundle exclusion/rebuild/asarUnpack handling, direct native degraded-load test, and native failure diagnostics.

tasks.title: Implement background indexing, chunking, metadata, and link graph
tasks.action: Add non-blocking IndexingService, latest-wins jobs, category/documentTags classification, heading-aware chunking, garu-compatible search_text, and persistent link graph extraction/reconciliation through dedicated modules with existing files used as adapters.

tasks.title: Implement bounded read-only hybrid smart_search

Only resolved link relations satisfy linked filters.

risks.description: External MCP responses can leak paths or credentials if redaction lands after save/search handlers.
risks.mitigation: Make PH-002 a hard prerequisite for save_document and smart_search.

risks.description: HNSW native dependency may fail under Electron packaging.
risks.mitigation: Lazy load native dependency and verify package smoke/degraded mode before release.

risks.description: Linked import can duplicate files or escape roots without source identity and containment.
risks.mitigation: Implement linked import only after source identity ledger and canonical broken-link diagnostics.
